01 / Capabilities

What I am developing.

01

Commercial awareness

Business administration, finance, sales, and resilience courses give me an introduction to how organisations work. I am learning to connect a business decision to its purpose, customers, and uncertainties.

02

Clear communication

School volunteering, writing, and languages give me ways to practise explaining an idea, listening carefully, and making the next step clear for someone else.

03

Thinking in systems

Aviation and technology make me curious about the work behind an outcome: who coordinates it, which information matters, and where responsibility sits.
